name: Payments UI
description: UI components, hooks, and state management for payment operations. Includes payment listing, detail views, refund handling, and filtering by status/method.

components.name: PaymentCard
components.description: Card component for displaying payment summary

components.name: PaymentList
components.description: List component with loading, error, empty states and filters

components.name: PaymentDetail
components.description: Detailed view for single payment with refund/retry actions

hooks.name: usePayment
hooks.description: Hook for single payment operations (fetch, refund, retry)

hooks.name: usePayments
hooks.description: Hook for payment list operations (fetch, filter, pagination)

stores.name: usePaymentStore
stores.description: Zustand store for payment state management

ai.summary: Complete UI module for payment management with components, hooks, and Zustand store. Follows Single Responsibility Principle with separate hooks for single and list operations. Supports multiple payment methods (PIX, credit card, boleto) and gateways.
use_cases: Display payment list with filtering by status and method
Show payment details with refund and retry actions
Process refunds with partial amount support
examples: const { payments, fetchPayments, filterByStatus } = usePayments({ status: 'pending' })

author: Bebarter Team
